name: Buckwheat cake
summary: Buckwheat seed ground to powder, mixed with water, poured into a soft mould, and rolled into a cake you will not mistake for any other.
origin: The Hà Giang plateau, in buckwheat season and at the November festival.
taste: A taste of its own, unlike any other cake on the plateau.
howToEat: Eat it as a cake while the buckwheat is in flower. The Đồng Văn festival is typically mid-to-late November.
The bloom runs from white in late September to pink through October and November and deep red by the end of December, and different counts put the season anywhere from October to December.
where: On the plateau in buckwheat season, and at the Đồng Văn festival.
seoTitle: Buckwheat cake in Ha Giang — banh tam giac mach
seoDescription: Bánh tam giác mạch is buckwheat ground to powder, mixed with water, moulded, and rolled. Eat it in flower season and at the November festival in Đồng Văn.
